summary.note: the same data jets serve every model, so the models' values are correlated

definition: the map built at 1 % with the W, top AND pseudo windows masked, on the data; shape change = eff(pseudo window) / eff(rest of its fit range) - 1 of the jets in the fit's bins; spurious = the fitted signal there at a fixed shape (centre, the model's top width); injected = expected counts of a Gaussian added to the passing bins, fitted back with the shape floating (peak_fit.fit_binned, float_shape)
